dedupe_keys.name: econome online risk and cost benefit tool for gravitational natural hazards switzerland

description: EconoMe is an online calculation tool commissioned by the Swiss Federal Office for the Environment that helps choose protection projects against gravitational hazards such as avalanches, debris flows and rockfall. It analyses the benefit-cost ratio of protection measures, so that their effectiveness (risk reduction) and economic efficiency can be judged, and it works with standardised scenarios and formulas so that assessed projects can be compared. Since 2008 protection projects must be assessed with EconoMe. The SLF has led its development since 2014, the rail tool EconoMe-Railway was integrated in 2015, and a simplified EconoMe-Light gives rough risk estimates. It is developed by a working group with GEOTEST, geoformer igp, Gutwein IT-Service, SBB, the Federal Roads Office (ASTRA), the cantons of Solothurn and Bern, the FOEN and the SLF, based on the natural hazard risk concept (RIKO). Access is restricted to authorised people and institutions, who can also install an offline version for practice; no price or licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: access is not open, and the standardised scenarios suit comparison more than site-specific detail. Coverage is Switzerland. It supports economic analysis and resilience planning of protection for roads, railways and settlements; the related record is the Engadin protection forest case study.
